jou.text: Raissa, a satyr on Theros, consults the starfish in a tidal pool during her pregnancy, and it shows her twins and then the boy crowding out the girl until only one child remains. Another vision shows her son fully grown with horns, destined to be a king, with worlds beyond Theros spinning around him, so she decides not to abandon him to Setessa as most satyr women would, since she believes he is special and needs her.

Years later Raissa escapes a burning house with her six-year-old son, who set her bed alight, after he had them cast out of Setessa by shoving a council member's son to his death from a high bridge. She returns with him to the tidal pools, where a vision shows the constellations of Nyx turning on him with outrage, and he rises to meet them on a cloud of power, ending the vision laughing with the impaled starfish held aloft on his stick.
